definition.description: REV | Scoring | Daily Summary. FR-021: counts of scored, auto-rejected and Borderline-awaiting-review applications, so the process owner has oversight without opening the system. Counts only, no identifiers (NFR-012). Safe to run twice. See notes.md.

metadata.description: Environment variable. The single recipient of the daily summary (C-TECH-047).

Environment variable. Base URL of REV Grant Administration for this environment, up to and including appid. Host and appid are both per-environment (C-TECH-047). Empty is handled: the view names render as plain text. See notes.md.

Every_weekday_morning.description: 07:00 UTC, Monday-Friday. Weekdays only: the summary prompts action, and nobody acts at the weekend. Monday's message covers the whole weekend, since the window is computed from the previous run, not a fixed 24 hours.

Compute_reporting_window_start.description: Three days back on a Monday, one day back otherwise, so the weekend is reported rather than skipped. Nothing scored between Friday 07:00 and Monday 07:00 falls through the reporting gap.

Initialise_failure_detail.description: Holds the failed action name and reason for the alert. Declared at the TOP level: the scope that fails is skipped from the failure onward, so nothing inside it can carry a value out.

Count_applications_scored_in_the_window.description: Anything with a rev_scoredon stamp inside the window. $select is rev_applicationid ONLY - the flow deliberately cannot see who these applications belong to.

Count_auto_rejected_in_the_window.description: Status 4 Auto-reject, scored inside the window.

Count_borderline_awaiting_review.description: Deliberately NOT windowed. FR-021 asks how many are Borderline AWAITING REVIEW - a backlog question. An ignored Borderline application must keep appearing until someone looks at it (NFR-018 observable daily).

Count_withheld_awaiting_review.description: Status 5 Under Review - FR-022 cases where a scored answer was missing so no outcome was issued. Not named in FR-021 but a derived addition: NFR-018 needs 100% of these reviewed too. Also a backlog count.

Post_the_summary_card.description: FR-021. Adaptive card with a button per view. PostCardToConversation has no precedent here, so the HTML message below runs if this fails and the summary still arrives. Counts only, never applicant detail. See notes.md.

parameters.body/messageBody: {"type":"AdaptiveCard","$schema":"http://adaptivecards.io/schemas/adaptive-card.json","version":"1.4","body":[{"type":"TextBlock","text":"Grant applications - daily summary","wrap":true,"weight":"Bolder","size":"Medium"},{"type":"TextBlock","text":"Since @{formatDateTime(outputs('Compute_reporting_window_start'), 'dd MMM yyyy HH:mm')} UTC:","wrap":true},{"type":"TextBlock","text":"\u2022  Scored: @{length(body('Count_applications_scored_in_the_window')?['value'])}","wrap":true,"spacing":"None"},{"type":"TextBlock","text":"\u2022  Auto-rejected: @{length(body('Count_auto_rejected_in_the_window')?['value'])}","wrap":true,"spacing":"None"},{"type":"TextBlock","text":"Waiting for you now:","wrap":true,"spacing":"Medium"},{"type":"TextBlock","text":"\u2022  Borderline awaiting review: @{length(body('Count_borderline_awaiting_review')?['value'])}","wrap":true,"spacing":"None"},{"type":"TextBlock","text":"\u2022  Under review, no score calculated: @{length(body('Count_withheld_awaiting_review')?['value'])}","wrap":true,"spacing":"None"},{"type":"TextBlock","text":"Counts only - no applicant details are included in this message by design.","wrap":true,"isSubtle":true,"size":"Small","spacing":"Medium"}],"actions":[{"type":"Action.OpenUrl","title":"Borderline awaiting review","url":"@{parameters('rev_GrantAdminAppUrl')}&pagetype=entitylist&etn=rev_application&viewid=e5a7b9c1-6003-4a2b-8c11-0a1b2c3d4e53"},{"type":"Action.OpenUrl","title":"Under review, no score","url":"@{parameters('rev_GrantAdminAppUrl')}&pagetype=entitylist&etn=rev_application&viewid=e5a7b9c1-6004-4a2b-8c11-0a1b2c3d4e54"},{"type":"Action.OpenUrl","title":"Auto-rejected","url":"@{parameters('rev_GrantAdminAppUrl')}&pagetype=entitylist&etn=rev_application&viewid=e5a7b9c1-6005-4a2b-8c11-0a1b2c3d4e55"}]}

Post_the_summary.description: Fallback for the card above: the same counts as HTML with anchors instead of buttons, so a rejected card payload still delivers the summary. See notes.md.

parameters.body/messageBody:
Grant applications - daily summary

Since @{formatDateTime(outputs('Compute_reporting_window_start'), 'dd MMM yyyy HH:mm')} UTC:

  • Scored: @{string(length(body('Count_applications_scored_in_the_window')?['value']))}
  • @{if(empty(parameters('rev_GrantAdminAppUrl')), concat('Auto-rejected: ', string(length(body('Count_auto_rejected_in_the_window')?['value']))), concat('Auto-rejected: ', string(length(body('Count_auto_rejected_in_the_window')?['value']))))}

Waiting for you now:

  • @{if(empty(parameters('rev_GrantAdminAppUrl')), concat('Borderline awaiting review: ', string(length(body('Count_borderline_awaiting_review')?['value']))), concat('Borderline awaiting review: ', string(length(body('Count_borderline_awaiting_review')?['value']))))}
  • @{if(empty(parameters('rev_GrantAdminAppUrl')), concat('Under review, no score calculated: ', string(length(body('Count_withheld_awaiting_review')?['value']))), concat('Under review, no score calculated: ', string(length(body('Count_withheld_awaiting_review')?['value']))))}
@{if(empty(parameters('rev_GrantAdminAppUrl')), '

Set the Grant Administration App URL environment variable to turn these into links.

', '')}

Counts only - no applicant details are included in this message by design.

Find_the_failed_action.description: The child of the failed scope whose status is Failed. result(scope)[0] was used before and returns the FIRST child, whose message on a nested scope is a generic wrapper - 11 alerts once said only "An action failed".

Describe_the_failure.description: Names the failed action and its reason for the alert.

Set_failure_detail.description: The failed action and its platform message.

inputs.name: failureDetail
inputs.value: @{concat('Action: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_action'))?['name'], 'unknown'), ' | Code: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_action'))?['error']?['code'], 'none'), ' | Reason: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_action'))?['error']?['message'], 'no message supplied by the platform'))}

Compose_run_link.description: Builds the deep link to THIS run and passes it to REV | Ops | Failure Alert. Both parts come from workflow() at run time, so nothing is hardcoded. It must be built here: workflow() in the child returns the child. See notes.md.

Alert_on_failure.description: Severity Warning rather than Error: a missed summary loses oversight for a day but loses no data and blocks no application, and over-classifying it would dull the alert channel that a genuine intake or scoring failure depends on.
